command: llvm-mc -triple=aarch64 -filetype=obj A64-P4-b-cond.s -o out.o && llvm-objcopy -O binary --only-section=.text out.o out.bin
notes: Input (33 B, `a:` / `  b.eq c` / `c:` / `  b.ne a` / `  b.gt a`): `b.eq` +4, `b.ne` -4, `b.gt` -8, with symbols `a` at 0 and `c` at 4. `llvm-mc` resolves all three locally (`llvm-readobj -r` prints an empty relocation list), so no linker is involved and the bytes are the assembler's own. The plan resolves the same displacements with `pcrel_begin` + `scale` shift 2, and states the condition as a `cond4` operand instead of a mnemonic suffix. Measured in `EXP-0014` §3.
source: Arm MRS B_only_condbranch, cond at 0+4, imm19 at 5+19
